title: DCSS 1st Grade ELA Pacing Calendar 2026-27
scope: Excerpts only: lesson-content lines ClassThread items cite. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information.
content:
[Jan 4–8; Unit 3 header] Jan 4–8  │  Unit 3: The Underwater World  │  Module 4, Sessions 26–30  │  4-day week – 5 sessions │  Heggerty Week 17
[Jan 4–8; I Can] I can read and write words with beginning blends fr, cr, dr, tr, gr, sn, sw; three-letter blends scr, spl, spr, str; ending blends -st, -sk, -mp, -nt; and long a_e.
[Jan 4–8; I Can] I can recognize and read contractions with 's and not.
[Jan 4–8; I Can] I can recognize and read words with closed syllables and words that end in -ed and -ing.
[Jan 4–8; Monday 4] Teacher Work Day
[Jan 4–8; Tuesday 5; Phonics row] No foundational skills — administer Integrated Literacy Unit 3 Assessment
[Jan 4–8; Wednesday 6; Phonics row] Beginning Blends with r and s; Closed Syllables and Endings -ed, -ing
[Jan 4–8; Thursday 7; Phonics row] Three-Letter Blends scr-, spl-, spr-, str-; Contractions with 's
[Jan 4–8; Friday 8; Phonics row] Ending Blends -st, -sk, -mp, -nd; Contractions with not; Long a: a_e; Plurals with CVCe words
[Jan 4–8; Wednesday 6; High-Frequency Words row] into, more, one, your, could, great, said, would
[Jan 4–8; Thursday 7; High-Frequency Words row] all, small, their, through
[Jan 4–8; Friday 8; High-Frequency Words row] any, many, most, want; other, people, too, write
